label: TP
reason: User-supplied header value flows directly into the response via concatenation in two locations within the welcome/remembered message block. The sanitize chain in doSomething (substring, split, Base64 round-trip) operates on a different variable derived from the same input but does not protect the actual user-facing output strings which concatenate the original param-derived values (via getName/getValue paths) without neutralization.

evidence.note: User input from Header flows into getValue()/getName() and is concatenated into response output without effective neutralization
